agent.problem: The phrase "withered branches like that" points back to the description on story card 12, which is no longer on screen. Make the question self-contained by identifying which branches Jesus is describing.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
